headline: Former Private Tutor Pleads Guilty To Sexual Offences Against 16 Girls
seoTitle: Private Tutor Pleads Guilty to Sexual Offences in Singapore
metaDescription: A former teacher and private tutor has admitted to committing sexual offences against 16 young girls, including his own niece and several students.
aiSummaryBullets: A former educator pleaded guilty to sexual offences against 16 girls aged between seven and 11.
The victims included the man's niece and 15 students under his private tutelage.
The defendant was arrested in September 2025 following a police report filed by a parent.
aiContextParagraph: A former school teacher, who later transitioned into private tutoring, has pleaded guilty to multiple sexual offences involving 16 minors. The victims, ranging from seven to 11 years old, consisted of the man's niece and 15 of his private tuition students. The investigation into the man's actions began after a parent of one of the victims lodged a report with the authorities. Law enforcement officers subsequently arrested the man, who is a father of two, on September 24, 2025. Following his arrest and the subsequent legal proceedings, the case has moved to the guilty plea phase. Legal representatives and court documents have confirmed the scope of the offences, which were carried out over a period during his employment as a tutor. The case has been reported on by multiple local news outlets, detailing the vulnerable age group of the victims and the defendant's prior background as an educator.
whyItIsViral: The case has gained attention through reporting by two independent news outlets, indicating significant public interest in the sentencing of the former tutor.
